svg.title: Kubernetes Explained for Busy Engineers
svg.desc: Editable vector recreation of the supplied ByteByteGo diagram. On the left, an engineer, CI, or GitOps updates a Deployment specification that is applied to the API server. The control plane maintains application Pods on two worker nodes, each with a container runtime, kubelet, and kube-proxy. On the right, browser traffic reaches an Ingress or Gateway, then a Service selecting the four Pods labelled app=checkout. The original simplified component model and branding are preserved.

g.text: How Kubernetes creates and keeps the app running
